dataset_design_options.leakage_risk: Low. Chronological splitting isolates data splits by year. Zero cross-instrument leakage risk.
dataset_design_options.operator_comparability: High. This is the direct baseline against which Version 1 metrics were calculated (TSS=0.2298 on test set).
dataset_design_options.scientific_novelty: None. Standard single-instrument time-series forecasting model.
dataset_design_options.advantages: Maximum data volume (16 years of coverage, 8.6M observations, 5.1M training windows). Highly representative of long-term solar cycles (e.g. Solar Cycle 24).
dataset_design_options.limitations: Model is blind to spatial, spectral, and multi-instrument diagnostics (soft/hard X-ray) from the Aditya-L1 observatory.

dataset_design_options.leakage_risk: Low. Uses strictly separate temporal ranges for train, validation, and test splits.
dataset_design_options.operator_comparability: Zero. The evaluation splits and time periods do not match the GOES-only baseline, making direct comparison of performance metrics (TSS, ROC-AUC) mathematically invalid.
dataset_design_options.scientific_novelty: High. Explores the predictive power of Indian solar space observatory telemetry (SoLEXS & HEL1OS) in isolation.
dataset_design_options.advantages: Captures high-resolution (5-second cadence) soft and hard X-ray measurements directly without needing to align with external satellites.
dataset_design_options.limitations: Very small dataset size (~915 days total duration). Completely lacks historical training contexts from Solar Cycle 24. Susceptible to telemetry gaps.

dataset_design_options.leakage_risk: Medium. Resampling and temporal alignment steps must be strictly causal to prevent future leakage across instrument timestamps.
dataset_design_options.operator_comparability: Low. The test period is limited to the overlap phase (starting 2025-12-15), which represents a subset of the baseline test set.
dataset_design_options.scientific_novelty: High. Combines multiple instruments across different orbits/viewpoints for joint solar nowcasting.
dataset_design_options.advantages: Allows direct multivariate fusion of background solar flux (GOES) with high-cadence local diagnostics (SoLEXS/HEL1OS).
dataset_design_options.limitations: Severely restricted training data volume. Restricting training to the overlap period discards 13 years of historical GOES records.

dataset_design_options.description: Transfer learning strategy (pretrain on GOES, fine-tune on overlap)
dataset_design_options.train_period: Pretrain: GOES 2010-01-02 to 2023-12-12; Fine-tune: Overlap 2023-12-13 to 2025-06-14
dataset_design_options.leakage_risk: Medium. Requires strict boundary validation to ensure pretraining data does not leak into validation/test splits.
dataset_design_options.operator_comparability: Medium. Direct comparison is possible on the overlap test split by evaluating the baseline model on the same subset.
dataset_design_options.scientific_novelty: Very High. Examines multi-modal representations where a temporal model pretrained on one satellite is adapted to another.
dataset_design_options.advantages: Retains long-term historical context of Solar Cycle 24 while incorporating new high-resolution instruments for local nowcasting.
dataset_design_options.limitations: Architectural complexity. The model must support variable feature dimensions (e.g. projecting GOES-only representations during pretraining and multi-instrument projections during fine-tuning).
